section_1_project_identity.project_title: Pune Urban Heat Island Mitigation & Street Canopy Initiative
section_1_project_identity.beneficiary_agency: Pune Municipal Corporation (Tree Authority & Road Dept)

section_2_problem_statement_baseline.thermal_baseline_source: Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 5-Year Pre-Monsoon Peak-Summer Composite (2021-2025)

section_3_target_geography.spatial_grid_type: Uber H3 Discrete Global Grid System
section_3_target_geography.administrative_ward_dependency: NONE (Decoupled; spatial allocation derives strictly from H3 topology)

section_7_modeled_microclimatic_and_risk.truth_layer: MODELED (Scenario projection under F-24.4 and F-24.5)
section_7_modeled_microclimatic_and_risk.governance_note: Risk reduction score 0.106048 represents the mathematical objective function achieved under the ₹10M budget envelope; it does NOT represent a guaranteed 10.6% clinical or ambient cooling outcome.

section_8_physical_implementation_plan.contractor_mobilization_protocol: Cell-level cluster batching adhering to F-24.1 minimum lot constraints
section_8_physical_implementation_plan.milestone_1: Site reconnaissance and roadside utility clearance (Month 1-2)
section_8_physical_implementation_plan.milestone_2: Procurement of indigenous saplings with 2m tree guards (Month 3)
section_8_physical_implementation_plan.milestone_4: Substantial completion and implementation event signoff (Month 6)

section_9_long_term_monitoring_protocol.monitoring_cadence: Annual pre-monsoon Landsat/Sentinel overpass audit (April DOY 95-115)
section_9_long_term_monitoring_protocol.in_situ_sensors: Periodic thermal pyrometer ground audits along treated road corridors

section_10_third_party_mrv_and_verificat.verification_methodology: CLIMORA Difference-in-Differences Verification Framework (F-26 / ISO 14064-2 aligned)
section_10_third_party_mrv_and_verificat.verification_gating_rule: Project cannot enter VERIFIED status without 100% passing MRV QC audit and certified independent audit event

section_11_scientific_assumptions_and_li.cooling_transfer_rate: 7.143e-4 °C per tree over Res9 cell area (MODELED scenario assumption)
section_11_scientific_assumptions_and_li.health_outcomes_claim: EXCLUDED (Model quantifies physical thermal screening, not epidemiological morbidity/mortality)
section_11_scientific_assumptions_and_li.causal_attribution: EXCLUDED (Causal claims require post-deployment MRV with matched control cells)
